title: Locked cards fill the row in Basic
caption: At Lv 4 in Basic on desktop, Daevanion and Stigmas show as faded shells beside Skills; Stigmas says 18 levels to go.

title: One level to go
caption: At Lv 21 the Stigmas shell counts down to 1 level to go before it opens at Lv 22.

title: The count in Advanced too
caption: Advanced keeps its shells and gains the same count under the unlock line; Daevanion opens after a quest, so it has none.

title: Phones stay as they were
caption: On a phone at Lv 4 the locked cards are still left out, so nothing pushes the page down.
